title: Florida House, District 81
what_it_does: Represents District 81 (Part of Collier) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Yvette Benarroch
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Co-owner of a landscaping business; licensed realtor; U.S. Air Force veteran; state representative since 2024
candidates.background: Yvette Benarroch was born in Puerto Rico, served in the U.S. Air Force during Operation Desert Shield/Desert Storm and moved to Florida more than 20 years ago. She co-owns Affordable Landscaping Service & Design in the Naples and Marco Island area, holds a real estate license, and has a bachelor's degree from the Inter-American University of Puerto Rico and a master's from Southern New Hampshire University. She chaired the Collier County chapter of Moms for Liberty, served as vice chair of the Collier County GOP, and was elected to the House in 2024.

candidates.name: Kim Finer
candidates.occupation: Retired professor of biological sciences (Kent State University); microbiologist
candidates.background: Kim Finer earned a Ph.D. in veterinary microbiology from Texas A&M University and spent most of a 35-year career as a professor of biological sciences at Kent State University. She bought a home in Florida in 2012 and is president of the Friends of Delnor-Wiggins Pass State Park; she is a member of the Conservancy of Southwest Florida and the League of Women Voters. This is her first run for office.
